content.thinking:
I'm checking the breakpoint math: the codemod's down('md') in v5 cuts off below 900px, while v4's down('sm') used 960px, so at 920px the compact flag comes out false. I'm also wondering whether an adaptV4Theme wrapper would change that, but it doesn't seem to.

I'm weighing whether a number argument to down() is the cleaner fix, since v5 accepts one, so I could pass 960 straight to the theme instead of hand-writing a max-width query.
